purpose: Existing49 water material diagnostic accuracy,0.25m additive patches over immutable1m base; no scene changes/candidate

classification_method.general: Actual BVH heights at sample and containing0.25m cell corners vary <0.25m
classification_method.true_discontinuity_nearby: Across sample/corner or corner/corner segment, bisect largest height-change half13 times; remaining jump>0.25m and last3 change ratios each>0.8. Continuous steep linear faces halve their delta and are not called discontinuities. This is a numerical geometric diagnostic at <0.1mm, not a symbolic topology proof.
classification_method.continuous_steep_or_fold: Cell varies >=0.25m but refinement did not establish a persistent finite jump. Includes genuine steep continuous faces and creases; errors remain included in full metrics.
classification_method.no_exclusions: No discontinuity sample is dropped from aggregate statistics; missing zero crossings remain explicit failures.

outside_feather_proof.strict_function: if no containing patch or edge distance<=0, return unchanged base sample directly. Four patch domains do not overlap.

limits: 0.25m bilinear heightfields cannot exactly represent vertical/overhanging upper-envelope jumps or arbitrarily thin wet rocks. Large maximum Y/depth errors are reported, not hidden by gridpoint accuracy. Visual A/B/A remains required.
